other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of West Bengal.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Minimum 60% marks in the Madhyamik Pariksha exam for High School; only students from the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education are eligible.
Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying exam for Diploma courses; courses must be approved by AICTE/PCI/CoA and affiliated to WBSCT&VE&SD.
Undergraduate students must have at least 60% aggregate in the HS exam conducted by WBCHSE/Madrasha Siksha Parishad.
Postgraduate students must have at least 53% marks in the Honours subject at the graduation level.

Kanyashree scholarship recipients (married or unmarried) pursuing PG in Science, Arts or Commerce with a minimum 45% in their undergraduate degree are eligible and are exempt from submitting income proof.
Research scholars (full‑time M.Phil. or Ph.D.) registered after 1 April 2017 are eligible (up to 2 years for M.Phil. and 4 years for Ph.D.).
Financial assistance stops for NET‑LS scholars upon their appointment as teachers.

Eligibility limited to specified courses: UG in Science, Arts, Commerce, Engineering, Medical, Technical/Professional; PG in Science, Arts, Commerce, Technical/Management; and research‑level M.Phil/Ph.D. scholars.
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship amounts range from ₹1,000 for HS and D.El.Ed students to ₹8,000 for non‑NET Ph.D. scholars, varying by course and level.
